title: Learning and Assessment Technical Reference
readerIntent: Understand the implemented quiz-oriented learning capability and extension boundaries.
priorKnowledge: Understand schemas, workflows, publishing, and user identity.
owner: Quizer capability family and consuming project modules
summary: Quiz, versioned quiz, and workflow-oriented quiz modules provide reusable assessment contracts; each learning application owns its curriculum, pedagogy, presentation, and learner journeys.

sections.heading: Capability map
items: Quiz definitions, questions, answers, attempts, scoring, and results according to active schemas/services.
Versioned authoring and approved publication where configured.
Workflow integration for review, assessment, or learning processes.
Tenant/user ownership, permissions, search, events, analytics, and operational evidence.

sections.heading: Extension
items: Project modules contribute learning-domain schemas, services, routes, workflows, content, and clients.
Do not place application curriculum or frontend journeys in the reusable framework module.
Validate scoring boundaries, retries, version changes, concurrent attempts, privacy, performance, accessibility, and regression.
